notes: Tuition: the only fee quoted on the programme page is 178 EUR/year. The page https://www.maroc.campusfrance.org/le-cout-des-etudes-les-bourses states differentiated tuition for non-EU students (2 902 EUR/year for Licence, '2 902 euros pour une année en cycle de Licence'), but that page is a general France-wide article, not this programme's page, and it also says institutions may exempt students; the 178 EUR figure on the programme page is the only amount quoted for this BUT. Duration: 3 years / 180 ECTS. Intakes: no dated or recurring international deadline is stated on the programme page; the ADIUT Maroc dates (1 October 2026 – 15 November 2026) appear on the general 1ère année BUT page and are not tied to this specific programme, so no intake was extracted. ApplicationChannel omitted per task instruction (foreign-diploma applicants use Études en France / Campus France).
